description.value: Produce Gone Wild is a fresh produce retailer with two Chilliwack-area locations built around direct relationships with Fraser Valley and Okanagan farmers who supply the stores seasonally. Their inventory runs from everyday staples to more exotic varieties, with an emphasis on local and regional sourcing. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a well-stocked selection of fresh fruit and vegetables, with curbside pickup and local delivery also on offer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was available from cache and served as the primary evidence source. The contact page confirms two active locations (Sardis: 7481 Vedder Rd Unit 2; Downtown: 45735 Alexander Ave Unit 2), phone 604-392-9453, and email office@producegonewild.com, along with active Instagram posts and weekly specials indicating the business is operating. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or washrooms are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced from the website contact page and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.

Business has two locations (Sardis: 7481 Vedder Rd Unit 2; Downtown Chilliwack: 45735 Alexander Ave Unit 2); the OSM node coordinates correspond to the Sardis location, but a separate OSM record may be warranted for the downtown location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating greengrocer with two confirmed Chilliwack-area locations and a current website. A useful fresh produce stop for touring cyclists in the Sardis corridor.

wow_evidence: two Chilliwack-area locations built around direct relationships with Fraser Valley and Okanagan farmers
